text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash and I receive wreaths from her parents in celebration of her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We talk about the wreaths, and I learn why she respects her parents so much and how important doing things the "right way" is to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her fixation on the Japanese Derby comes from a desire to please her mother, which is a surprisingly straightforward reason for her rigorous work ethic.
